annotations.title: Verify NY LLC State Filing Package

description: Checks whether a Certificate of Publication filing package for the New York Department of State is complete, from what the person says they have: the Certificate of Publication form for the entity type (DOS-1708-f domestic, DOS-1707-f foreign, DOS-1709-f PLLC), the notarized affidavits of publication from both newspapers (daily and weekly), the $50 filing fee by check, money order or credit card authorization (Form DOS-1515-f), signatures, and the Department's address. With the LLC's name, county and formation or qualification date it also lists what to match on the form against the Filing Receipt. Returns a checklist of what is ready and what is missing. An automated checklist, not legal advice. Do NOT use for notice text (use llc_publication_verify_ad_compliance or llc_publication_generate_ad_text), the process overview (use llc_publication_get_process_guide), or requirements (use llc_publication_check_requirements).

county.description: County where LLC office is located — used to verify form content

formation_date.description: Formation/qualification date from Filing Receipt — used to verify form content

have_daily_affidavit.description: Whether user has the affidavit from the daily newspaper

have_form_1708f.description: Whether the completed Certificate of Publication form is ready (DOS-1708-f for a domestic LLC, DOS-1707-f for a foreign LLC, DOS-1709-f for a PLLC)

have_weekly_affidavit.description: Whether user has the affidavit from the weekly newspaper

llc_name.description: Exact LLC name as filed with NY State — used to verify form content

payment_method.description: How they plan to pay the $50 filing fee

name: llc_publication_verify_filing_package
title: Verify NY LLC State Filing Package
